# Code Anchors: Release Template Lookup

- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-lookup.ts` — the release template set, the source choice (pointer checkout, travelling copy, or source checkout when run from source), and the refusals for an unknown name, a missing template and an unreadable install location.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-lookup.spec.ts` — coverage for each source, each refusal, and that a repository template folder is never returned.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the lookup verb that prints the location, and the retired seeding verb that refuses and names it.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-payload.ts` — packs the release template set beside the executable.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.ts` — the build-time check that every name a shipped stage asks for is in the set.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-retirement.spec.ts` — the retired seeding verb writes nothing and exits non-zero.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — asks the lookup for the approval-first or old-format template and stops on failure or empty output.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — asks the lookup for the standards template in its prerequisites step, before it writes anything.
- `common/templates/decision-record-template.md`, `common/templates/decision-record-template-v1.md`, `common/templates/standard.template.md` — the three templates the release ships.
